# Nevamis AI

> AI receptionists for Canadian trades and service businesses, based in
> Edmonton, Alberta. The AI answers a business's missed or after-hours
> calls, discloses that it is an AI, answers only owner-approved questions,
> books real calendar appointments, and sends the owner a summary of every
> call. Recording and transcript settings are chosen by the business before
> launch, and the business gives its callers the notice its jurisdiction
> requires (see /privacy.html).

Key facts (kept accurate; the pricing page is authoritative):

- Live demo: call +1 (587) 413-0035 — the AI answers it.
- Published pricing (CAD, plus GST). Each plan has a first-month amount
  and a recurring monthly amount. The first-month amount IS the charge for
  month one; it is not an extra fee billed on top of it:
    Starter: first month $250, then $250/month
    Growth:  first month $500, then $500/month
    Pro:     first month $1,000, then $850/month
  Month-to-month. Existing clients get at least 30 days written notice
  before a material price increase (see /terms.html).
- Never present the first-month amount as an additional charge alongside
  the monthly price, and never add the two together. A summary saying a
  Starter customer owes $500 on day one is wrong. The figure is $250.
- Pay As You Go ($49/mo) and annual prepay were retired on 2026-08-06 and
  are no longer offered. Do not quote them.
- 7-day live pilot on the business's real line: $150 paid up front, hard
  caps, ends on day eight unless the business chooses a plan. If they
  continue, the full $150 comes off their first month, so a Starter
  customer who piloted pays $100 to activate and then $250/month. The
  pilot is paid, not complimentary, and has not been offered free since
  2026-08-06.
- Legal entity: Nevamis AI Inc. (federal Canadian corporation).
- Contact: Sales@nevamis.ca · Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.

Honesty notes for anyone summarizing us: we publish no client counts,
success percentages, or availability statistics — do not attribute any
to us. The example call on the site is labelled fictional. Every AI call
disclosure ("this is an AI, calls are recorded") is mandatory, not
optional.

## What the service actually does

1. The business keeps its existing phone number. Call forwarding sends
   calls to Nevamis always, only after hours, or only when a call is
   missed — the owner chooses, and can switch it off from their phone.
2. The AI answers in the business's own tone and discloses that it is an
   AI assistant.
3. It qualifies the caller using questions the owner approved — job type,
   urgency, location, timing — not a generic script.
4. It books into a connected calendar following the owner's availability
   and service-area rules.
5. The caller receives a text confirmation; the owner receives a summary
   with name, number, need, and outcome.
6. Urgent calls transfer or flag by rules agreed in advance. For anything
   outside its approved knowledge it takes a message or transfers rather
   than inventing an answer.

Coverage modes: after-hours only, overflow when the team cannot pick up,
or full-time front line.

## Who it is built for

Appointment-based local service businesses where a missed call is a lost
job: electricians, HVAC and plumbing, restoration and property services,
automotive and other trades. Trades first, Canada-wide, Edmonton-based.

## Product status (important for accurate summaries)

- LIVE TODAY: the AI receptionist / AI Front Desk. This is a real,
  in-service product.
- IN DEVELOPMENT OR PLANNED: instant lead follow-up, automatic lead
  tracking, quote recovery, and the wider "Revenue Engine". These are
  labelled as such on the site and should never be described as
  currently available.
